Manager info

Hi all! Here's everything you need to know this season. Thanks for helping run your teams — looking forward to a great summer of soccer.

Dates

Season schedule

  • Kick-off: 9 October
  • Wrapping up: 11 December
  • Round robin: 9 rounds
  • Finals: Week 10 (format confirmed closer to the date)
The draw

How rounds work

With 8 teams, each round has 4 games — no bye needed. See the Fixtures tab for the full schedule.

Location

Where we're playing

Round 1 (9 Oct): confirmed at Ron Payne Oval.

From Round 2 onward: not yet confirmed. The permanent venue is still being sorted out — we'll update this as soon as it's locked in.

Note: Ron Payne has no lighting, which is why Round 1's kick-off is earlier than usual.

Game times

Format & kick-offs

  • Games are 20-minute halves
  • Self-refereed — teams call their own games
  • Game 1: 6:00 PM
  • Game 2: 6:50 PM

Rounds 1–4: everything shifts 20 minutes earlier (5:40 PM / 6:30 PM). Round 1 is at Ron Payne Oval.

Set-up

Weekly set-up duty

The team playing in the first game each week handles set-up beforehand — moving the goals into place, setting out cones and flags, and marking lines with the paint cans.
